affordance_in_statement: It is guaranteed that the linear span of the entire catalog of E shift vectors has a dimension of exactly N - 1. ... Each shift vector has exactly two non-zero coordinates in the standard basis: a value of 1 at coordinate u and a value of -1 at coordinate v. ... E = N − 1.

common_affordance: The shift vectors form the incidence matrix of a connected tree, so satisfying all critical pair differences is exactly the problem of selecting the unique critical-vertex spanning subtree.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its DFS-based subtree accounting does not correctly compute the union of all required critical-to-critical paths, despite the tree structure making those paths forced.
It explicitly assumes the answer is an MST on the graph induced by critical vertices, incorrectly excluding noncritical Steiner vertices that may be required to connect the critical vertices.
Its heap-based traversal/greedy connection approach does not identify exactly the forced edges in the critical spanning subtree and therefore can select or omit edges incorrectly.
